tagline.en: Taiwan's longest expressway, untolled, down the west coast from the Tamsui river mouth to Tainan, built piece by piece over three decades
tagline.zh: 台湾最长的快速公路，不收费，自淡水河口沿西海岸南下台南，三十年间一段段拼接而成

start.en: Shifen interchange, Qigu District, Tainan — the southern end of the open road until the Zengwen River bridge is finished
start.zh: 台南市七股区十份交流道——曾文溪桥完工前的通车终点

end.en: Tamsui end, at Shalun, Tamsui District, New Taipei, reached over the Danjiang Bridge since May 2026
end.zh: 新北市淡水区沙仑淡水端，2026 年 5 月起经淡江大桥衔接

en: Provincial Highway 61 runs down Taiwan's west coast from the mouth of the Tamsui River to Qigu in Tainan, through New Taipei, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, Miaoli, Taichung, Changhua, Yunlin, Chiayi and Tainan. Planned at 301.834 km, it is the longest expressway in Taiwan; the highways directorate gave the open length as 287.972 km in 2020. In the north it shares a corridor with Provincial Highway 15, in the centre and south with Highway 17.

It is a provincial expressway, so unlike the national freeways it charges no toll, and with most of it now grade-separated it is used as a free alternative to Freeways 1 and 3 — hence its nickname. The main line is two lanes each way throughout, with frontage roads alongside for motorcycles and slow traffic.

It is still not one continuous expressway. Between the Fengshan River bridge and Jinshui bridge in Hsinchu there is a gap, where traffic uses Highway 15, and south of Shifen the bridge over the Zengwen River is under construction.
zh: 台 61 线自淡水河口沿台湾西海岸南下至台南七股，途经新北、桃园、新竹、苗栗、台中、彰化、云林、嘉义与台南。计划长度 301.834 公里，是全台最长的快速公路；公路总局 2020 年公布的通车长度为 287.972 公里。北段部分路段与台 15 线共用路廊，中南部部分路段与台 17 线共用路廊。
它属于省道快速公路，不像国道那样收取通行费；加上大部分路段已改为封闭式道路，常被当作国道一号、国道三号的免费替代道路，因而有「穷人的高速公路」之称。主线全线双向四车道，两侧另有侧车道供机车与慢车行驶。
它至今仍不是一条完全连续的快速公路：新竹凤山溪桥至浸水桥之间尚有断链，暂以台 15 线替代；十份以南跨越曾文溪的桥梁仍在兴建中。

en: The road was meant to be fully grade-separated, on viaduct. Residents along several early sections, with their local representatives, objected that a closed road would spoil the view and the fengshui and cut them off from trade, so the main line was built at ground level with signalled junctions instead of interchanges: Hsinchu to Houlong, Yuanli to Da'an, Shengang to Lukang and Mailiao to Taixi among them. A decade and more later, for safety, those sections began to be lifted onto viaduct: Xianxi–Fuxing reopened grade-separated in September 2013, Taixi in 2014 and Fangli to Da'an in March 2018. The 23 level crossings still left between New Taipei and Miaoli are being removed under a plan approved in 2023.

Its new northern end is the Danjiang Bridge over the Tamsui River mouth, designed by Zaha Hadid's office: a single-tower asymmetric cable-stayed bridge 920 m long, with a 211 m tower and a 450 m main span, carrying the expressway, a reserved light-rail track, motorcycle lanes and a footway. It opened on 12 May 2026.

At its southern end the Zengwen River bridge, 3.38 km long, crosses a wetland of international importance; it was begun on 20 December 2022 and is due in 2028. Other notable structures are the Xibin Bridge over the Zhuoshui River, the first piece of the road to open, and the 2,250 m Fengbiwei tunnel in Hsinchu, built as a covered "false tunnel".
zh: 这条路原本设计为全线高架的封闭式道路。但多处早期路段的沿线居民伙同民意代表抗议，认为封闭式道路会破坏景观、风水并阻碍经济发展，于是主线改为平面道路，以平交路口取代交流道，新竹至苗栗后龙、苗栗苑里至台中大安、彰化伸港至鹿港、云林麦寮至台西等路段皆是如此。通车十余年后，又因行车安全而陆续办理立体化：线西至福兴段 2013 年 9 月立体化通车，台西交流道 2014 年完成，房里至大安段 2018 年 3 月完成。新北至苗栗路段剩下的 23 处平交路口，则依 2023 年核定的计划改善中。
新的北端起点是跨越淡水河口的淡江大桥，由扎哈·哈迪德建筑师事务所设计：单塔不对称斜拉桥，全长 920 米，桥塔高 211 米，主跨 450 米，桥上设快速公路车道、预留的轻轨专用道、摩托车道与人行道。2026 年 5 月 12 日通车。
南端的曾文溪桥长 3.38 公里，跨越国际级湿地，2022 年 12 月 20 日动工，预计 2028 年完工。其他重要结构物包括跨越浊水溪、全线最早通车的西滨大桥，以及新竹长 2,250 米、以「假隧道」形式兴建的凤鼻尾隧道。

en: The Western Coastal Highway was already being built as an ordinary road when, in 1992, to relieve the Sun Yat-sen Freeway, the government of Hau Pei-tsun raised it to expressway standard and made it part of the Six-Year National Development Plan, as a third north–south corridor beside Freeways 1 and 3. Its first piece, the Xibin Bridge, had opened in July 1991.

Protests, land acquisition, money and the later lifting of at-grade sections onto viaduct meant it was built in fits and starts. Sections opened from 1995 onwards, more than thirty times in all. On 25 June 2005 part of a viaduct under construction near Tongxiao collapsed, killing six. In 2006 the environmental authority ordered the Yuanlin drainage–Dacheng section in Changhua reassessed because of its effect on Eurasian curlews.

When the original programme ran out in 2007, it left gaps that discouraged drivers from using the road. A follow-on plan approved in 2009 joined eight of them, and on 27 December 2019 the Fangyuan–Dacheng section opened at the seventeenth opening ceremony, 28 years after the first; the road was then described as open throughout, apart from the Hsinchu gap.

Since then it has kept growing at both ends. In June 2020 the Executive Yuan moved its start to Shalun in Tamsui, over the new Danjiang Bridge, and cut it back in the south to end at Tainan's Taijiang Avenue beyond the Zengwen; a feasibility report for closing the Hsinchu gap was approved that July. Fog caused a pile-up of 21 vehicles at the 255 km mark in Yunlin on 21 February 2021, killing two, after which the transport minister ordered 16 fog detectors for the length of the road. On 10 April 2026 the Executive Yuan approved a feasibility study for carrying it on south to Kaohsiung.
zh: 西部滨海公路原本就在以一般公路标准兴建；1992 年，为纾解中山高速公路的拥塞，郝柏村内阁将其提升为快速公路标准，纳入「六年国建」，与国道一号、国道三号构成三条南北向运输走廊。最早通车的西滨大桥已于 1991 年 7 月启用。
由于民众抗争、征地、政府财政困难，以及平面路段改高架等问题，工程只能盖盖停停。自 1995 年起分段通车，总计超过三十次。2005 年 6 月 25 日，通霄附近兴建中的高架桥发生坍塌，造成 6 人死亡。2006 年，彰化员林大排至大城段因对大杓鹬生态有所冲击，环保署环评委员会决定该路段须重做环评。
2007 年原建设计划结束时留下多处断点，降低了用路人使用意愿。2009 年核定的后续建设计划把其中 8 处接通；2019 年 12 月 27 日芳苑至大城段通车，举行第 17 次通车典礼，距第一段通车已 28 年，除新竹断链外宣告全线可通。

此后它仍在两端继续延伸。2020 年 6 月，行政院公告将起点改至淡水沙仑、经新建的淡江大桥，南端则改为跨过曾文溪后接台南台江大道止；同年 7 月，新竹凤鼻至香山段可行性评估报告获核定。2021 年 2 月 21 日，云林段北上 255 公里处因浓雾发生 21 辆车连环追撞，2 死 8 伤，其后交通部长敲定全线设置 16 处浓雾侦测器。2026 年 4 月 10 日，行政院核定台 61 线南延至高雄地区的可行性评估报告。

en: The original programme, Raising the Western Coastal Highway to an Expressway, was budgeted at NT$94.6 billion for 1992–1996. It was revised three times as sections were deferred, land prices and seismic standards changed and parts were moved onto viaduct, ending at NT$84.184 billion with its term stretched to 2006. The 2009 follow-on plan was approved at NT$77.5095 billion and later cut to NT$73 billion as contracts came in, of which only NT$14 million — for land — was a local-government share.

Su Tseng-chang, the premier, put the total at about NT$150 billion over 27 years when announcing completion in October 2019. Since then the money has gone into new pieces: the Danjiang Bridge, approved at NT$14.1 billion in 2010 for a shorter, 8.5 km scheme, ended at NT$23.038 billion after its main span failed to attract a contractor seven times and steel prices rose; the Zengwen River bridge rose from NT$6.636 billion to NT$9.627 billion in 2022; removing the 23 level crossings in the north is budgeted at NT$27.782 billion.
zh: 最初的「西部滨海公路提升为快速公路计划」，计划期程 1992 至 1996 年度，经费 946 亿元。其后因路段缓办、地价与耐震系数调整、部分路段改为高架等原因三度修正，最终为 841.84 亿元，期程延至 2006 年度。2009 年的后续建设计划核定 775.095 亿元，后依实际发包金额下修为 730 亿元，其中只有 0.14 亿元用地费由地方负担。
2019 年 10 月宣布即将完工时，行政院长苏贞昌称这条路历时 27 年、耗资约 1,500 亿元。此后的经费投入新路段：淡江大桥 2010 年核定时为全长约 8.5 公里、141 亿元的方案，因主桥段连续 7 次流标及原物料上涨，最终总经费达 230.38 亿元；曾文溪桥由 66.36 亿元于 2022 年追加至 96.27 亿元；北部 23 处平交路口改善则编列 277.82 亿元。

en: Limits are 70 to 90 km/h on the main line; lorries over 20 tonnes have been held to 80 km/h since 2023. Heavy motorcycles over 550 cc have been allowed on the main line since November 2007, and those of 250–550 cc since July 2012; other motorcycles must use the frontage roads. Through the Hsinchu gap and the remaining at-grade sections expect signals.
Rest areas are few and mostly recent: Kouhu in Yunlin, the first, opened in 2021, followed by Xinfeng and Da'an in 2023 and Xinpu in 2024. Fog is a hazard in Yunlin and Chiayi.
zh: 主线速限为每小时 70 至 90 公里；20 吨以上大货车自 2023 年起限速 80 公里。排气量 550 cc 以上的大型重型机车自 2007 年 11 月起可行驶主线，250 至 550 cc 者自 2012 年 7 月起开放；其余机车须行驶侧车道。经过新竹断链及其余平面路段时会遇到红绿灯。
沿线休息站不多，且多为近年设立：首座口湖休息站 2021 年启用，新丰、大安休息站 2023 年启用，新埔休息站 2024 年启用。云林、嘉义一带须留意浓雾。

value.en: About NT$150 billion over 27 years to 2019, as stated by the premier; not broken down by year or checked against the plans' accounts. The plans themselves were budgeted at NT$84.184 billion (1992–2006, final revision) and NT$73 billion (2009–2019).
value.zh: 据行政院长所述，至 2019 年历时 27 年耗资约 1,500 亿元；未按年度拆分，也未与各计划决算核对。各计划本身的经费为 841.84 亿元（1992—2006 年度，第三次修正）与 730 亿元（2009—2019 年）。

figures.source: 顧荃, 「蘇貞昌：西濱快速公路109年春節前完工通車」, Central News Agency, 31 October 2019; Directorate General of Highways, 西濱快速道路網站, 計畫歷程 (archived May 2020)

value.en: Central government, through the Directorate General of Highways; of the NT$73 billion follow-on plan, NT$14 million of land costs fell to local government
value.zh: 中央政府经由公路总局出资；730 亿元的后续建设计划中，地方负担用地费 0.14 亿元

figures.source: National Development Council, 「西濱快速公路後續建設計畫」查證報告

value.en: NT$23.038 billion total for the bridge and its approaches, about 12 km (NT$14.1 billion for an 8.5 km scheme at approval in 2010)
value.zh: 大桥及两端联络道约 12 公里，总经费 230.38 亿元（2010 年核定 8.5 公里方案时为 141 亿元）

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 淡江大橋, citing the Directorate General of Highways and Central News Agency

value.en: NT$9.627 billion after a NT$3 billion increase approved in August 2022
value.zh: 2022 年 8 月行政院追加 30 亿元后为 96.27 亿元

figures.source: Liberty Times, 14 September 2022, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 西部濱海快速公路

value.en: 301.834 km planned; 287.972 km open (2020 figure, before the Danjiang Bridge)
value.zh: 计划长度 301.834 公里；通车长度 287.972 公里（2020 年数据，未含淡江大桥）

figures.source: Executive Yuan notice, 29 June 2020, and Directorate General of Highways, 省道公路路線, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 西部濱海快速公路

value.en: Directorate General of Highways, through its temporary West Coast Highway engineering offices (north and south)
value.zh: 交通部公路局，由西部滨海公路北区、南区临时工程处办理

figures.source: Directorate General of Highways, 西濱快速道路網站

timeline.en: The Xibin Bridge over the Zhuoshui opens in July, the road's first piece.
timeline.zh: 7 月，跨越浊水溪的西滨大桥通车，为全线最早通车路段。

timeline.en: The road is raised to expressway standard under the Six-Year National Development Plan.
timeline.zh: 纳入「六年国建」，提升为快速公路标准。

timeline.en: A viaduct under construction collapses near Tongxiao on 25 June; six die.
timeline.zh: 6 月 25 日，通霄附近兴建中的高架桥坍塌，6 人死亡。

timeline.en: The Executive Yuan approves the follow-on plan to close eight gaps.
timeline.zh: 行政院核定后续建设计划，接通 8 处断点。

timeline.en: The Xianxi–Fuxing section reopens on viaduct on 12 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 12 日，线西至福兴段立体化完工通车。

timeline.en: Fangyuan to Dacheng opens on 27 December; the road is declared open throughout, bar the Hsinchu gap.
timeline.zh: 12 月 27 日芳苑至大城段通车，除新竹断链外宣告全线可通。

timeline.en: The start is moved to Tamsui over the Danjiang Bridge on 29 June; a feasibility report for the Hsinchu gap is approved in July.
timeline.zh: 6 月 29 日起点改至淡水、经淡江大桥；7 月新竹凤鼻至香山段可行性评估报告获核定。

timeline.en: A fog pile-up at the 255 km mark kills two on 21 February.
timeline.zh: 2 月 21 日，255 公里处浓雾连环追撞，2 人死亡。

timeline.en: Work on the Zengwen River bridge begins on 20 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 20 日曾文溪桥动工。

timeline.en: A study of extending the road to Kaohsiung is approved on 10 April; the Danjiang Bridge opens on 12 May.
timeline.zh: 4 月 10 日南延高雄可行性评估获核定；5 月 12 日淡江大桥通车。
